portraits.subject: girl aged 8, round youthful cheeks, chestnut hair in two low pigtails, light warm skin, brown eyes
portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square pixel art portrait asset for a modular city game resident character sheet. Detailed elegant classic pixel art, visible deliberate square pixel clusters on a logical 256x256 grid, crisp hard edges, no smooth gradients, no blur, no antialiasing, no text, no border, no montage. Front-facing head and shoulders, perfectly upright head, symmetrical frontal pose, gaze straight forward, neutral closed mouth, fully clothed plain muted slate crew-neck shirt at bottom. Plain uniform very light cool gray background. Soft consistent upper-front-left lighting, warm skin ramps and dark brown pixel contours. Critical standardized geometry expressed in the final logical 256x256 pixels: face center x128, left pupil x102 y116 and right pupil x154 y116; eyebrow baseline y102; nose tip x128 y145; closed mouth center x128 y166; chin center x128 y195; ears centered y130; temples around x80 and x176; shoulders extend to bottom corners y255. Keep these feature positions regardless of age. Hair occupies y12..95, no hair crossing eyebrows or eyes, ears visible. Age represented by skin texture, cheeks and hairstyle rather than shifting eyes/nose/mouth. Head fills same frame at same scale in every asset. Facial feature rendering should resemble refined warm-toned 1990s RPG portrait pixel art, not cartoon caricature, not photorealistic painting. Output ideally 256x256 pixels. Subject: girl aged 8, round youthful cheeks, chestnut hair in two low pigtails, light warm skin, brown eyes
